symptoms: Small reddish-brown raised spots on leaves
Spots may appear on both leaf surfaces
Leaves can yellow as infection grows
maize_common_rust.organic_remedy: Remove badly affected leaves and clear plant debris.
maize_common_rust.chemical_remedy: Azoxystrobin + propiconazole or mancozeb; follow the local label dose.
prevention: Rotate crops and remove volunteer maize

symptoms: Long rectangular gray or tan leaf spots
Spots follow the leaf veins
Lower leaves are often affected first
maize_gray_leaf_spot.organic_remedy: Remove infected crop residue and rotate away from maize.
maize_gray_leaf_spot.chemical_remedy: Pyraclostrobin, azoxystrobin, or propiconazole; follow the local label dose.

symptoms: Leaves show no clear disease spots
Leaf color appears generally even
maize_healthy.organic_remedy: Keep watering evenly and remove weeds around plants.

symptoms: Long cigar-shaped gray-green lesions
Lesions grow longer and turn tan
Several lesions may join across the leaf
maize_northern_leaf_blight.organic_remedy: Remove infected crop residue and rotate crops after harvest.
maize_northern_leaf_blight.chemical_remedy: Azoxystrobin, propiconazole, or pyraclostrobin; follow the local label dose.

symptoms: Brown spots with ring-like marks
Yellowing around spots
Lower leaves affected first
tomato_early_blight.organic_remedy: Remove infected lower leaves; improve airflow and avoid wetting leaves.
tomato_early_blight.chemical_remedy: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or azoxystrobin; follow the local label dose.
prevention: Water at the base, not on leaves

symptoms: Leaves show no clear disease spots
Leaf color appears generally even
tomato_healthy.organic_remedy: Keep watering evenly and remove weeds around plants.

symptoms: Water-soaked dark patches on leaves
Patches spread quickly in damp weather
White growth may appear under leaf patches
tomato_late_blight.organic_remedy: Remove affected leaves and dispose of infected plants away from the field.
tomato_late_blight.chemical_remedy: Mancozeb, cymoxanil + mancozeb, or metalaxyl-M + mancozeb; follow the local label dose.

symptoms: Small round spots with dark edges
Spots may have pale centers with tiny dark dots
Older lower leaves often yellow and drop
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.organic_remedy: Remove spotted lower leaves and avoid working with wet plants.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.chemical_remedy: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb; follow the local label dose.
